original_question: Nri Carl kacha nwe mmasị bụ chiizi. Ọ riri otu Sanwichi kwa ụbọchị n'izu ụka a maka nri ehihie na-ewere iberibe chiizi abụọ na sanwichi ọ bụla. O riri chiizi na omeleti maka nri ụtụtụ ụbọchị atọ n'izu ụka jiri otu iberibe ọzọ kwa omeleti karịa sanwichi. O siri nnukwu nri nke makaroni na chiizi ka o zuoro ya nri abali maka izu uka ahụ ma jiri iberibe chiizi 8 n'ime ya. Iberibe chiizi ole ka o jiri mee ihe?
